from common import *
import argparse,traceback,gc,resource

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('variant',choices=VARIANTS);p.add_argument('seed',type=int);p.add_argument('--attempt',type=int,default=1);a=p.parse_args()
    assert a.seed in SEEDS and 1<=a.attempt<=5;save_source(__file__);harness('check')
    progress=read(PROGRESS);check(progress['prepared_inputs']);assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in progress['jobs'])
    job=f'{STAGE}-{a.variant}-s{a.seed}-a{a.attempt}';previous=[j for j in progress['jobs'] if j['variant']==a.variant and j['seed']==a.seed]
    event={'type':'fit_start','job_id':job,'variant':a.variant,'seed':a.seed,'label_horizon':5,'command':[sys.executable,__file__,*sys.argv[1:]]}
    if previous:event['retry_of']=previous[-1]['job_id']
    harness('event',event);progress['jobs'].append({'job_id':job,'variant':a.variant,'seed':a.seed,'attempt':a.attempt,'status':'running','phase':'preparing','pid':os.getpid(),'started_at':time.time()});write(PROGRESS,progress)
    try:run(a,job)
    except BaseException as exc:
        out=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-failure.json';progress=read(PROGRESS);write(out,{'job_id':job,'error':repr(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'phase':progress['jobs'][-1]['phase'],'model_fit_called':'fit_started_at' in progress['jobs'][-1]});progress['jobs'][-1].update(status='failed',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(out));write(PROGRESS,progress);harness('event',{'type':'fit_result','job_id':job,'outcome':'failed','evidence':[fingerprint(out)]});raise

def run(a,job):
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,lightgbm as lgb,qlib
    from backtest.scripts.train import train_regime_arm as tr
    from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from style_metric import score as style_score
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT);qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    prepared=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');sub=prepared['subsets'][a.variant];check(sub['target']);target=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/sub['target']['path']);fm=read(FEATURE);parts=[]
    for year in range(2004,2021):
        b=fm['blocks'][str(year)];fp=FEATURE.parent/b['path'];check({**b,'path':str(fp)});f=pd.read_pickle(fp);y=target.loc[target.index.get_level_values('datetime').year==year]
        assert y.index.isin(f.index).all();x=f.reindex(y.index);x.columns=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([['feature'],f.columns]);x['label','LABEL0']=y.to_numpy();parts.append(x)
    train=pd.concat(parts,copy=False);del parts,f,x,y;gc.collect()
    assert train.index.equals(target.index) and len(train)==sub['rows'] and train.shape[1]==165
    assert hash_array(train['label','LABEL0'].to_numpy())==sub['label_sha256'];xsha=hash_array(train['feature'].to_numpy());tsig=tr.frame_signature(train)
    vm=read(VALID);vp=VALID.parent/vm['blocks']['frame']['path'];check({**vm['blocks']['frame'],'path':str(vp)});cached=pd.read_pickle(vp);valid=cached['frame'];tradable=cached['tradable'];del cached
    valid=valid.loc[valid.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23')];tradable=tradable.reindex(valid.index)
    expected=read(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1/docs/inputs-h20.json');vsig,msig=tr.frame_signature(valid),tr.frame_signature(tradable)
    assert vsig==expected['valid_signature'] and msig==expected['tradable_signature']
    weights=models.compose_day_weights(train.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(train))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS)));wsha=hash_array(weights.to_numpy());assert wsha==sub['weight_sha256'];del weights,target;gc.collect()
    labels=day_labels();days=pd.DatetimeIndex(valid.index.get_level_values('datetime').unique()).sort_values();assert len(days)==1448
    score_dates=set(days) if a.variant=='ALL' else set(days[day_map(days,labels).eq(a.variant).to_numpy()]);assert len(score_dates)==scored_days(a.variant)
    if a.variant!='ALL': assert day_map(train.index.get_level_values('datetime').unique(),labels).eq(a.variant).all()
    params=dict(tr.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);params['early_stopping_rounds']=50
    model=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=a.seed,es_metric='top5_h5_net_ann',tradable_mask=tradable,**params)
    control=next(c for c in read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['components'] if c['seed']==a.seed);expected_params=read(ROOT/control['training']['path'])['parameters'];assert model.params==expected_params
    inp={'training':tsig,'feature_array_sha256':xsha,'label_values_sha256':sub['label_sha256'],'label_receipt':sub['target'],'validation':vsig,'tradable':msig,'weights_sha256':wsha,'parameters':model.params,'es_scope':a.variant,'granularity':STAGE,'validation_context_days':1448,'scored_days':len(score_dates),'scored_dates':[str(d.date()) for d in sorted(score_dates)],'daily_labels':fingerprint(REGIME),'source':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/adapter-train.json')}
    inp_path=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-inputs.json';write(inp_path,inp)
    rounds=[];notes=[];latest=[];eligible=tradable.fillna(False).to_numpy(dtype=bool)&np.isfinite(valid['label','LABEL0'].to_numpy());dates=valid.index.get_level_values('datetime');groups=[p.to_numpy() for _,p in pd.Series(np.flatnonzero(eligible),index=dates[eligible]).groupby(level=0)]
    def ties(pred):
        counts={3:0,5:0}
        for pos in groups:
            if len(pos)<20:continue
            values=pred[pos];top=np.partition(values,len(values)-6)[-6:];top.sort();counts[3]+=int(top[2]==top[3]);counts[5]+=int(top[0]==top[1])
        return counts
    receipt=read(BASE/'docs/fast-metric-verification.json')
    use_fast=receipt['passed']
    context=None
    def metric(pred,label,index,tradable=None):
        nonlocal context
        latest[:]=[pred]
        if use_fast:
            from fast_metric import TopFiveContext
            if context is None: context=TopFiveContext(label,index,tradable)
            target,full,counts,reverse=context.scores(pred,score_dates)
        else:
            target,full=style_score(pred,label,index,tradable,score_dates);counts=ties(pred)
            reverse=style_score(pred[::-1],label[::-1],index[::-1],tradable,score_dates)[0]['net_ann'] if counts[5] else target['net_ann']
        notes.append({'round':len(notes)+1,'top3_boundary_tie_days':counts[3],'top5_boundary_tie_days':counts[5],'reverse_priority_score':reverse,'full_window_score':full['net_ann'],'target_style_score':target['net_ann'],'scored_days':target['n_days']});return target['net_ann']
    def observer(env):
        try:
            assert np.isfinite(env.evaluation_result_list[0][2]) and np.isfinite(latest[0]).all(),'nonfinite prediction or score'
            tree=env.model.dump_model(start_iteration=env.iteration,num_iteration=1)['tree_info'][0]
            rounds.append({'round':env.iteration+1,'objective':float(env.evaluation_result_list[0][2]),'tree_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(tree,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
            write(BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-round-trace.json',{'job_id':job,'round':env.iteration+1,'rounds':rounds,'notes':notes})
        except BaseException:
            env.model.save_model(str(BASE/'data'/f'{job}-interrupted-model.txt'),num_iteration=env.iteration+1);raise
    observer.order=25;observer.before_iteration=False
    old_metric=models.top5_h5_net_ann;old_train=lgb.train
    def observed_train(*args,**kw):kw['callbacks']=[*kw['callbacks'],observer];return old_train(*args,**kw)
    models.top5_h5_net_ann=metric;lgb.train=observed_train
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['jobs'][-1].update(phase='fitting',fit_started_at=time.time());write(PROGRESS,progress);print('FIT',job,train.shape,valid.shape,'scoring',len(score_dates),'days',flush=True);started=time.time()
    try:model.fit_prepared(train,valid)
    finally:models.top5_h5_net_ann=old_metric;lgb.train=old_train
    elapsed=time.time()-started;model.rankic_evals_result[0].update(scoring_scope=a.variant,scored_days=len(score_dates),context_days=1448,turnover_context='full_calendar',granularity=STAGE)
    session=f'dftfour_20261113_{a.variant.lower()}_s{a.seed}'
    summary={'arm':'m0','model':'single','seed':a.seed,'label_horizon':5,'label_expr':'Ref($close,-6)/Ref($close,-1)-1','label_quantization':'H5-quantile10-old-recipe','training_regime':a.variant,'granularity':STAGE,'es_metric':'top5_h5_net_ann','es_valid_source':'eval_window','es_scoring_scope':a.variant,'es_scored_days':len(score_dates),'es_context_days':1448,'es_label_window_policy':'exit_within_eval_window_h5','rankic_evals':model.rankic_evals_result,'fit_seconds':elapsed,'train_shape':list(train.shape),'input_receipt':str(inp_path.relative_to(ROOT))}
    session_dir=tr.save_session('m0',a.seed,session,model,summary,weight_arm='m0');meta=read(session_dir/'meta.json');meta.update(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),owner_experiment=EID,stage='weekly-h5-four-20261113',granularity=STAGE,training_regime=a.variant,es_scoring_scope=a.variant,es_scored_days=len(score_dates));write(session_dir/'meta.json',meta)
    out=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json';result={'job_id':job,'session':session,'model':fingerprint(session_dir/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model'),'input_receipt':fingerprint(inp_path),'parameters':model.params,'early_stopping':model.rankic_evals_result,'rounds':rounds,'tie_diagnostics':notes,'fit_seconds':elapsed,'max_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'old_model_replication':'Not an acceptance gate; training membership intentionally changed, so exact old model is not expected.'};write(out,result)
    del train;gc.collect();pred=pd.Series(model.model.predict(valid['feature'].to_numpy(),num_threads=8),index=valid.index,name='score');assert np.isfinite(pred.to_numpy()).all()
    panels=ev.daily_head_panel(pred,valid['label','LABEL0'],[3,5],tradable=tradable);heads={str(k):{str(d.date()):sorted(v) for d,v in panels[k]['sets'].items()} for k in [3,5]};hp=BASE/'data'/f'{job}-valid-heads.json';write(hp,heads);result.update(selected_valid_heads=fingerprint(hp),selected_prediction_sha256=hash_array(pred.to_numpy()),selected_boundary_ties=ties(pred.to_numpy()));write(out,result)
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',phase='complete',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(out),session=session);write(PROGRESS,progress);harness('event',{'type':'fit_result','job_id':job,'outcome':'succeeded','evidence':[fingerprint(out),result['model']]});print(json.dumps({'job':job,'best':model.model.best_iteration,'rounds':len(rounds),'fit_seconds':elapsed,'peak_GiB':result['max_rss_bytes']/1024**3}),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
